metadata.source: Hand-reviewed BLASTOFF category lists plus the repository's curated Wikidata brand registry and country/category subsets.
metadata.scoring: Fixed five-level estimated rarity tiers. Curated lists retain editorial values; registry-derived subsets use Wikidata popularity as a conservative proxy. Scores are frozen before play.
